enrichment.core_claim: Aquaphotomics reads water spectral patterns as integrated system state, detecting microtubule polymerization and anesthetized versus awake states, suggesting water participates in consciousness.
enrichment.ask_question: Which water spectral bands changed most between anesthetized and awake states?
enrichment.challenge_question: Could water spectral changes under anesthesia simply reflect temperature or metabolic shifts rather than anything about consciousness?
